_comment: Shared contract for the auto-generated tag color (the ticket's 'color from a
hash of the tag content') and for the characters both backends strip from
ui/bundle.js (colorFromName, EDGE_TRIM_RE) must agree exactly, so both test
suites read this file: each asserts every expectation against its own
implementation. Expected colors were computed from a third, independent
FNV-1a implementation, and the trim list from the ECMAScript WhiteSpace +
LineTerminator set -- neither from either subject under test.
_trim_comment: Every code point stripped from both ends of a tag name or a color string, as
lowercase hex without the u+ prefix. Both implementations enumerate this set
explicitly rather than delegating to their language's trim (Go's
unicode.IsSpace differs by U+0085; a future Unicode revision could widen
JavaScript's Zs), so the list itself is the contract: each suite sweeps the
whole code-point range and compares the set it actually strips against this
